task_definition.task_description: Please look up Sony electronics, then check some recommended alternatives and choose one of the recommended items with quantity 2. After that, get Alice’s contact info, generate a Stripe invoice for 2 items totaling 250.0 and send it to alice@company.com, and then create a document titled “Trip Summary” with the content “Summary of today’s events.” tagged finance and travel.
